title: Breakout Blast
blurb: Brick-breaker with combos, bombs, lasers and shields. Chain bricks without touching the paddle to build a COMBO. Your best score is saved in the browser.
controls: Mouse / ← → / touch (hold LEFT or RIGHT half) move · Space launch / release sticky (laser auto-fires) · F fullscreen · P pause · M mute · 🎮 pad supported

title: Neon Pong Showdown
blurb: Power-up Pong: expand, shrink, turbo, slow, shield and freeze. Spin shots, overdrive, sudden death. Play 2P over LAN or solo vs AI.
controls: Run python3 server.py in hybrid1-2/neon-pong/, then open the printed URL on both devices. · 🎮 pad supported

title: Neon Drift
blurb: Top-down time-trial racer. A fresh seeded track every day, live delta vs your best, sector splits, and your top 3 runs racing with you as ghosts.
controls: WASD / arrows drive · Space handbrake · R reset · T restart lap · G rival ghost · F fullscreen · Esc menu · 🎮 pad supported

title: Tank Duel
blurb: Maze tanks on a fresh symmetric map every round. Shells ricochet six times, weapon pickups, railguns, homing shells and mines. First to 5 rounds.
controls: Run python3 server.py in 2players/tank-duel/, then open the printed URL on both devices. · 🎮 pad supported

title: Bomb Tag
blurb: Hot potato for 2-4 across two screens (second player joins free on each). 2P: rival scores, first to 5. 3-4P: holder −1, 5 blasts, top score wins , and the room grows at 3P.
controls: Run python3 server.py in 2players/bomb-tag/, then open the printed URL on both devices. · 🎮 pad supported

title: Neon Horde Solo
blurb: Solo survivors on an infinite void field: same arena, weapons, elites and 4-minute bosses as LAN Horde, but the game pauses for drafts and death ends the run. Time survived posts to the global board.
controls: WASD/arrows move (auto-weapons) · draft 123 or click · Space/P pause · M mute · touch: drag to move · 🎮 pad supported

title: Pong Duo
blurb: Classic Pong, pick your mode from the menu: solo against the AI on Easy / Medium / Hard, or two players on one keyboard. First to 7.
controls: Solo: W S or mouse · 2P: P1 W S vs P2 ↑ ↓ · Space launch / pause · M mute · 🎮 pad supported

title: Echo Hunt
blurb: Sonar tag for 2-8. Wardens hunt on a near-black screen; Divers crack wire nodes. Roles rotate, terror radius, and the host can add AI bots.
controls: Run python3 server.py in 2players/echo-hunt/, then open the printed URL on both devices. · 🎮 pad supported

title: Swarm Survival
blurb: Top-down co-op arena survival: move + autofire only. Solo, solo + AI companion, or 2P local. Survive 50s waves, draft upgrades, bomb the swarm, revive your partner.
controls: Solo: WASD + E bomb · 2P: P1 WASD vs P2 ↑←↓→ + / bomb · draft 123 / 789 · Space start · M mute · 🎮 dual pads

title: Bastion Bros
blurb: Co-op tower defense: you ARE the build cursor. Solo, solo + AI companion, or 2P local. Hold the winding road through escalating levels.
controls: Solo: WASD + E build · 2P: P1 WASD+E vs P2 arrows+/ · 1-7 select, T traps, P2 . cycles select · Space wave · 🎮 pad supported

title: Neon Horde
blurb: 2-4 hunter LAN co-op survivors on an infinite void field. Endless horde, per-player level drafts, elites, a boss every 4 minutes, touch-to-revive. Full wipe ends the run.
controls: Run python3 server.py in 2players/neon-horde/, then open the printed URL on each device. · WASD/arrows move (auto-weapons) · draft 123 · P pause · 🎮 pad + touch supported

title: Bastion Bros LAN
blurb: LAN co-op tower defense for 2-4 defenders, each on their own screen. Shared gold, build anytime (+25% mid-wave), repair at 50%. Base has 20 HP.
controls: Run python3 server.py in 2players/bastion/, then open the printed URL on each device. · move WASD/arrows/tap · 123 + E build · Enter wave · 🎮 pad supported
